text:
maria: Quick sync 3 looking to run a nightshift, SLO-gated feature flag rollout for the new model routing. Target window Sat 2026-03-28 01:00-04:00 UTC. Need thumbs and ops checklist.

aj: I like the window. Proposed ramp: canary 1% (10m), micro 5% (15m), mid 20% (30m). Holdpoint at end of each stage for telemetry review.

olivia: For gating, require both: error rate (5xx + model-infer-failures) < 0.5% AND p95 latency < 300ms. Also require two consecutive 5m buckets to fire an alert to avoid flapping.

sam: Add auto-pin behavior: if a holdpoint triggers at any stage >1%, deploybot should pin cohort traffic back to previous stable version. Manual rollback must be possible if pin doesn't restore behavior.

maria: Good. Deploy-bot, can you create the scheduled job with these parameters and annotate release notes with pin/rollback steps?

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2026-03-28T01:00Z -> 2026-03-28T04:00Z. Rollout plan created with ramp segments. Auto-pin on breach configured.

Runbook snippet (copy into ops doc):

```
# schedule command for release infra
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \
  --window "2026-03-28T01:00Z/2026-03-28T04:00Z" \
  --ff routing.v2_toggle --ramp "1:10m,5:15m,20:30m" \
  --hold "errors>0.5% OR p95>300ms" --hold-aggregation "2x5m" \
  --on-hold notify:oncall-ops --on-breach action=pin(previous) \
  --fallback route:model-quantized-v1 --meta-tag rollout_tag=slo-night-03-28
```

oncall-ops: I'll cover the shift. I'll publish a small smoke test (healthcheck + low-traffic inference) to run post-stage. If we hit a holdpoint I'll run the rollback playbook and post updates here.

aj: Also recommend enabling a temporary variant fallback on hold so traffic goes to quantized-v1 while we triage. Less risk and should keep the customer traffic alive.

olivia: Please ensure telemetry emits `rollout_tag=slo-night-03-28` so post-incident analysis can slice by cohort and region. Include model-variant and shard id in logs.

sam: Draft release note: "Night window deployment for routing.v2 toggle. Three-stage ramp with SLO gates and auto-pin on breach. Model-variant fallback enabled. Oncall monitoring active." Keep it short for the public changelog.

maria: One more safety: if a holdpoint pauses for >20m the deploy must not auto-resume. Manual resume required and we should run a short blameless post-check.

oncall-ops: I'll set alerts to require 2 consecutive 5m buckets for both metrics. I'll attach screenshots of the alert config before EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: Note: If automated pin fails (e.g., routing API error), deploy will escalate to oncall and mark the rollout as paused. Manual intervention required.

aj: Ops guidance: if p95 briefly spikes but errors remain flat, prefer to hold and let caches warm (see cache-warming checklist) instead of immediate rollback. Use the manual unblock checklist.

olivia: Agree. Also add a small telemetry check for quality regressions: sample 1% of generation outputs and run the quick eval script to detect hallucination regressions. If quality delta > 3% we should consider rollback even if SLOs hold.

sam: Good call. Add that to the runbook under "quality gates".

maria: All approvals? If so I'll mark APPROVED and publish the release notes. :thumbsup:

olivia: Approved.

aj: Approved.

sam: Approved.

oncall-ops: Approved 3 I'll be oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and published. Notifications will post to #eng-sre and #eng-releases at T-30m and at start.
